data.narrative:
Viken Detection is a Series C-stage defense and security company that has raised $50M to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 12 same-sector and adjacent-stage peers, including 8 private companies (Quantum-Systems, Helsing, Saronic, Chaos Industries, Shield AI, Anduril Industries, Neros, and Dream Security) and 2 public equities (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS). The peer set spans valuations from $300M to $18.0B, with a median of $2.3B.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression methodology, using the $50M total raised as a proxy base value and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies a valuation of $85M. Peer-median analysis across the 12-company comparable set implies $2.3B, reflecting the substantial valuations achieved by later-stage peers including Helsing ($18.0B Series D), Saronic ($9.2B Series D), and Quantum-Systems ($8.0B Series C).

The wide divergence between methods reflects material uncertainty about Viken's relative position within the cohort. The triangulated range spans $72M (low) to $2.7B (high), with a median of $1.2B. The low-end estimate anchors to capital-raised progression; the high-end reflects the upper quartile of peer valuations. Key uncertainties include Viken's revenue scale, customer concentration, and technical differentiation relative to the sampled peer set.
